children.title: Caliper
children.description: Emrick Donadei — https://github.com/edonadei/caliper · https://pypi.org/project/caliper-eval/ — 🆕 pass@k reliability harness for agent skills: runs a skill k times against Claude Code / Codex / pi, grading each attempt with an LLM-autorater () and/or deterministic Python (), then a re-run without the skill reports the delta to prove the skill beats the base agent. Git-diffable specs; isolated per-attempt sandboxes.
